Requested ratios define block assignment fractions; ceil rounding, extended edge blocks, quality filtering, and buffers change patch/pixel fractions.

Whole patches are removed only when their complete footprint is too close to a retained higher-priority split (test, then validation, then train). Compact group selection maximizes retained quality pixels subject to split/class coverage; no model score is used.
AOI edges, nodata/quality exclusions, and seams within the same split do not create buffers.
Optional class labels affect patch quality and seed coverage only; the continuous-field variogram is computed independently before label filtering.
